intent: one KPI with label, value, optional delta/trend/hint/badge
useWhen: Showing a single metric such as revenue, users, or conversion rate
A KPI with a trend against a target, or progress toward a goal or limit — sparklineVariant reference or meter
doNotUseWhen: A full chart or a table — use LineChart, BarChart or Table; Scorecard only takes a small decorative sparkline
A framed content tile — use Card
A recommended action tile — use InsightCard

deltaTone.note: Override the delta color (default from trend: up success, down danger). warning (text-warning) for an amber count such as '3 urgent' without a badge that makes the card taller than its neighbours. The icon follows trend; with trend neutral the tone's status icon replaces the dash (TriangleAlert, CircleX, CircleCheck).

badge.note: kit Badge on the header, aligned with label. Compose Badge; status is not a Tag.

sparkline.note: number[], oldest first. A small trend line under the value in --chart-1, full width, --space-6 tall. Decorative (aria-hidden): delta and hint carry the meaning. Needs two or more finite numbers; others are skipped.

sparklineVariant.note: plain: the thin --chart-1 line (unchanged). reference: area fill, faint grid, a dashed reference line with its label, darker dots on the last highlightLast points, start and end dates (sparklineDates). expressive: smooth curve, soft area, dashed previous period (compare) in --chart-5 with a This period / Previous legend, an end dot with the latest point's value (compact, e.g. 4.3k) in a small mono tag, and a faint band on the latest point. Both move the chart to the card's foot so cards in a row line up. Needs two or more finite numbers; otherwise nothing is drawn.

reference.note: sparklineVariant reference only. A dashed text.muted guide on the same scale as the line, e.g. { value: 400, label: 'Target $400k' }.

compare.note: sparklineVariant expressive only. number[], oldest first: the previous period, drawn dashed in --chart-5 on the same scale. Adds the legend.

highlightLast.note: sparklineVariant reference only. Darker dots on the last N points, e.g. the weeks past a target.

sparklineDates.note: sparklineVariant reference only. Start and end labels under the line, e.g. ['Aug 28', 'Nov 20'].

meter.shape: { value: number, max: number, label: string, direction?: 'higher' | 'lower' }
meter.note: A calm bar toward a target in place of the sparkline: kit Meter (bar, sm) with the percent of max on the left and label on the right, e.g. { value: 2.1, max: 3, label: 'of 3.0% limit', direction: 'lower' }. direction defaults to higher. The bar is neutral; with direction lower and value over max it turns warning and the row shows the word Over limit, so the state is not colour alone. max must be above 0. The progressbar is named by the card label and meter label.

appearance.note: card is the framed tile. plain drops the border and background for a divided strip (Scoreboard appearance divided passes it); hover and selected states still draw.

onClick.note: When set, the whole card is a button that opens a detail view

selected.note: With onClick: the card is a toggle in a picker (e.g. the metric a chart shows). Sets aria-pressed, draws the selected style (border.brand on action.selected), and adds the badge to the button's name. Leave undefined for a plain button.

selectionRole.note: With onClick and selected. toggle sets aria-pressed. radio sets role radio and aria-checked, for a card inside a radiogroup; Scoreboard selectable sets it, so you rarely pass it.

fill.note: Stretch to the parent width. Scoreboard passes fill so cards share the row.

requirements: delta text is the visible change
deltaTone is color only; the delta text carries the meaning
root is a button when onClick is set
with onClick and selected set, the button has aria-pressed and its name includes the badge text
sparkline is aria-hidden and not focusable
with selectionRole radio, the button has role radio and aria-checked instead of aria-pressed
reference and expressive drawings, dates and legend are aria-hidden; delta and hint carry the meaning
meter composes kit Meter: role progressbar named by the card label and meter label; the percent and label text under it are aria-hidden

doNot: Do not invent a KpiCard, Stat, or MetricCard cousin
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not pack multiple KPIs into one Scorecard
Do not put buttons or links inside Scorecard besides the whole-card onClick
Do not invent a local Tag or Status on Scorecard — status uses kit Badge via badge
Do not draw a local sparkline beside Scorecard — pass sparkline
Do not use sparkline as the only sign of change; keep delta or hint
Do not draw a local meter or bar beside Scorecard — pass meter
Do not color the sparkline or meter with brand; brand is only for the selected card
Do not pass reference, highlightLast or sparklineDates without sparklineVariant reference, or compare without expressive; they are ignored
snippet:
<Scorecard label="Revenue" value="$48.2k" delta="+12.4%" trend="up" hint="vs last 30 days" />

<Scorecard label="Active users" value="12,480" badge="+3.1%" badgeTone="success" sparkline={[11.2, 11.6, 11.9, 12.1, 12.48]} />

<Scorecard label="MRR" value="$412.6k" hint="vs previous 3 months" sparkline={mrr} sparklineVariant="reference" reference={{ value: 400, label: "Target $400k" }} highlightLast={4} sparklineDates={["Aug 28", "Nov 20"]} />

<Scorecard label="Churn rate" value="2.1%" hint="vs previous 3 months" meter={{ value: 2.1, max: 3, label: "of 3.0% limit", direction: "lower" }} />

<Scorecard label="MRR" value="$412.6k" sparkline={mrr} sparklineVariant="expressive" compare={mrrPrevious} />
